Metadata.description: Receive your parcels at a trusted neighbor or local shop in Portugal.

Home.title: Never miss a delivery again
Home.lead: Have parcels delivered to a verified neighbor or local shop near you, then collect them when it suits you with a one-time pickup code.

steps.title: How it works
steps.find: Find a host near you on the map
steps.reserve: Reserve and use their address at checkout

demo.title: Explore the demo
demo.body: This is a frontend-only portfolio project: everything runs in your browser with mock data. Jump straight in with a ready-made account:
demo.customerHint: Find hosts and reserve a pickup
demo.hostHint: Accept parcels and hand them over

Home.disclaimer: Vizinho has no integration with merchants or carriers. Whether a delivery can be made to a host's address depends on each merchant and carrier.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: It's free while Vizinho is in its pilot.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
signup.acceptTerms: I accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.termsRequired: You need to accept the terms to continue.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

customer.subtitle: Track your parcels and find hosts nearby.
customer.emptyBody: Find a verified host near you and reserve a pickup spot before you order.
customer.howBody: Reserve a host, use the address they share at checkout, then collect your parcel with a one-time code.
customer.hostCtaBody: Become a host: receive parcels for people nearby and earn a little for each pickup.

host.subtitle: Manage requests, parcels in storage and your availability.
host.capacityValue: Up to {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} at a time
host.openingSlotsValue: {count, plural, =0 {Not set} one {# weekly slot} other {# weekly slots}}
host.noListing: You don't have a host listing yet.

ComingSoon.body: This part of Vizinho is on the roadmap.

customer.findHost: A full-screen map that uses your location to show approved hosts nearby, with their hours and rules.
customer.parcels: Your reservations and parcels, with live status updates and one-time pickup codes.
customer.help: Answers to common questions and a way to report a problem with a parcel.

host.requests: Accept or decline reservation requests before your address is shared.
host.storage: Check parcels in with a photo, see what's stored and hand parcels over with a pickup code.
host.schedule: Set your weekly opening hours, time off and how many parcels you can hold.

admin.hosts: Review and approve host applications, and suspend hosts if needed.
admin.reservations: Every reservation's lifecycle and custody trail.
admin.incidents: Investigate damaged, missing or unknown parcels and resolve disputes.
admin.audit: An append-only log of every privileged action.

Hosting.title: Become a host
Hosting.subtitle: Receive parcels for your neighbours and earn a little for each pickup.

status.pendingBody: An admin will review it soon. You can't edit it while it's in review.
status.rejectedBody: Update your application and submit it again.
status.approvedBody: Your listing is live. Manage requests and parcels from your host area.
status.suspendedBody: Customers can't find or book you. Parcels you hold can still be collected.

listing.intro: Tell customers who you are and what you can receive.
listing.displayNameHint: Shown to customers, e.g. “Hugo in Arroios”.
listing.rulesTextHint: Floor, buzzer, how long you keep parcels, anything customers should know.

sizes.medium: Medium: up to a cabin bag

listing.maxValueHint: You won't receive parcels declared above this. Up to €1000.

hours.intro: When can customers collect parcels? One time window per day.

location.intro: Pin your address on the map. Customers only see an approximate area until you accept their reservation.
location.noResults: No addresses found. Try the street name and number.
location.resultsCount: {count, plural, one {# address found} other {# addresses found}}. Use the up and down arrows to choose.
location.searchFailed: Address search isn't available right now. Move the map to place the pin, then type your address.
location.attribution: Address search by Photon · © OpenStreetMap contributors
location.geolocationDenied: Location access was blocked. Search for your address or move the map instead.
location.geolocationUnavailable: Your location isn't available. Search for your address or move the map instead.
location.mapLabel: Map. Move it so the pin sits on your door.
location.mapHint: Move the map so the pin sits on your door. Zoom in for precision.
location.privacyBody: Only the shaded square (about 400 m across), until you accept their reservation. Your exact address is shared only then.
location.accessInstructionsHint: Buzzer name, entrance, floor. Shared only after you accept a reservation.

submit.intro: When every step is done, send your application to our team.
submit.agreement1: I only receive parcels for reservations I've accepted in Vizinho.
submit.agreement2: I keep parcels safe and unopened, and hand them over only with a valid pickup code.
submit.agreement3: I record every check-in and handover honestly in the app.
submit.agreement4: I can refuse any parcel, and I never accept prohibited items.
submit.acceptAgreement: I agree to the host agreement
submit.incompleteHint: Complete the steps above to submit.
submit.submitted: Application sent. We'll let you know when it's reviewed.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.locked: Your application is in review and can't be changed right now.
errors.alreadySubmitted: This application has already been submitted.
errors.maxValue: Enter a whole number of euros from 1 to 1000.
errors.closesBeforeOpens: Closing time must be after opening time.
errors.noHours: Open on at least one day.
errors.acceptAgreement: You need to accept the host agreement.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.invalidTransition: That action isn't possible for this listing's current status.
errors.noteRequired: Add a note explaining the decision.
errors.addressLine1: Enter the street and number (3–120 characters).
errors.locationRequired: Place the pin on your door: search for your address or move the map.
errors.outsidePortugal: Vizinho hosts must be in mainland Portugal.

Demo.note: Everything here is mock data, saved only in this browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
Demo.resetHint: Restores the original hosts, reservations and accounts. Accounts you created are removed.

AdminHosts.subtitle: Review applications and manage hosts.

empty.pending_review: No applications are waiting for review.

AdminHosts.locationHint: The pin is the exact location. Customers only see the shaded square.
AdminHosts.privateHint: Hidden until you need it. Every view is recorded in the audit log.
AdminHosts.noteHint: Required to reject or suspend. The host will see it.
AdminHosts.ownListing: This is your own listing. Another admin has to review it.
